descr.name: A screen to identify genes that regulate lymphatic endothelial cell migration - Primary Screen
description: Genome wide siRNA screen for modulators of lymphatic endothelial cell migration
protocol: The transfection is performed in duplicate in 96 well plates labelled A and B.

The human siRNA library (Dharmacon GE) consists of 18,120 individual protein coding genes consisting of the following gene families: Protein kinases (G-003505), GPCR (G-003605), Phosphatases (G-003705), Ion channel (G-003805), Drug targets (G-004655), Remaining genome (G005005).
siRNA - 21 bp chemically synthesized sequences, arrayed format (96 well plates, diluted in 1x siRNA buffer (Dharmacon GE source).
Unique siRNA molecules per reagent pool:

SMARTpool siRNAs (Dharmacon RNAi Technologies). 4 individual siRNAs targeting each gene, pooled together in one well. Ideally, the 4 sequences will target all isoforms/transcript variants of a gene and they are generally in the coding region.
15000 cells per well were plated in a 96 well plate
Dharmacon RNAi Technologies for siRNA. Invitrogen for Celltracker Green CMFDA and Hoechst 33342.
High content imaging scratch assay for cell migration and cell number.

All siRNA and lipid/opti-MEM complexing is performed in 1 plate (A plate) and subsequently transferred to assay plate B.  Transfer 8 ul of siRNA stock (1 uM) to assay plate 'A', mix well and transfer 20 ul to assay plate 'B'. Incubate for 20 min at room temperature to complex.  Final concentration of SMARTpool is 40 nM. All liquid handling steps performing using a Calliper Sciclone ALH3000 liquid handling robot. Cells were reverse transfected by adding 80ul of cells (15000 cells) per well to the pre-mixed siRNA/lipid complex using a Biotek 406 (Biotek) dispense workstation.
15000 cells per well were plated in a 96 well plate
siRNA is added to pre-diluted lipid in opti-MEM, mixed and complexed for 20 minutes.
96 well, Black/Clear, tissue culture treated imaging plate, flat bottom with lid

"Transfection: EGM-2 media (Lonza; catalogue #CC3156), 5% FCS, with EGM-2MV Singlequots of: VEGF, EGF, IGF, FGF2, Hydrocortisone, Ascorbic acid (Lonza; catalogue #CC4147).10mM HEPES also added. (No antibiotics)
Growth media: as above, plus GA1000 (gentimycin and amphotericin)"
Average "area migrated over" values of technical replicates for each siRNA, normalised to mean "area migrated over" value for mock-transfected wells.
"Average ""area migrated over"" values for each siRNA, were normalised to mean ""area migrated over"" value for mock-transfected wells, and then converted to robust z scores using the formula:
siRNAs were binned as 'Inhibited' (robust z score < -2) or 'Accelerated' (robust z score > 2)
Average "cell nuclei count" values of technical replicates for each siRNA.
Cell count binning classification: LOW_CELL_COUNT (low cell number): value < 3300, NC (no change): value > 3300
Combined (MIGRATION_Z_SCORE_BIN and AVERAGE_CELL_COUNT_BIN) bins, with AVERAGE_CELL_COUNT_BIN taking priority.
Wells are flagged as NOT_POSSIBLE when SSMD could not be calculated for that plate due to exclusion of a positive control well
Wells are flagged with ONE REP when one of the two replicate wells were excluded for technical reasons (e.g. failure to scratch, contamination)

results.name: MIGRATION_AVERAGE_NORMALISED_TO_MOCK

description: Migration robust Z-score binning classification: ACCELERATED (high migration score): value > 2, IMPAIRED (low migration score): value < -2, NC (no change): 2 > value > -2

results.name: AVERAGE_CELL_COUNT
description: Cell count data for each replicate, then averaged the values across the 2 replicates.
